text:
Maria G: Heads-up: platform will start honoring a new routing hint header next week: X-Route-Policy. We'll support values `prefer-cost` and `prefer-latency`. Need SDK teams to normalize header casing and accept the old `route_hint` legacy key as a fallback. Also want a lightweight telemetry tag `X-Quota-Context` so console can map requests to quota buckets. cc @Kevin W @Sophia C

Kevin W: For Go SDK — can we make this opt-in? worried changing defaults might break customers who rely on current routing behavior.

Sophia C: DevEx preference is opt-in for GA, but we should ship an automatic remap for the legacy key to avoid immediate breakage. UX ask: console should show the "effective policy" per route so product teams can validate.

Danny (platform): Plan proposal: compatibility layer server-side for 90 days, default server behavior unchanged. SDKs should expose an explicit `route_policy` option and an env var to opt-in. We'll add server-side fallback that maps old `route_hint` -> X-Route-Policy when present.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-api compatibility toggle -> canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC :robot_face: (link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat-canary)

Kevin W: ok. I'll add a Go shim with `RoutePolicy` option and an env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_SHIM=off|opt-in|auto`. Suggest default `auto` to preserve behavior for now.

Maria G: Product asked for opt-in by default in the review. If we choose `auto` we need strong telemetry for the first week to detect surprises. Please add a telemetry event `sdk.route_policy_override` when shim changes incoming behavior.

Sophia C: I'll update the Python + TS RFCs. Proposed Python snippet for header normalization:```python
def _set_route_headers(headers, route_policy=None, legacy=None):
    # prefer explicit route_policy param, then fallback to legacy key
    if route_policy:
        headers['X-Route-Policy'] = route_policy
    elif legacy:
        headers['X-Route-Policy'] = legacy
    # ensure quota context present for console mapping
    headers['X-Quota-Context'] = headers.get('X-Quota-Context', 'sdk:py:unversioned')
```

Kevin W: I'll prototype the Go implementation with `auto` default behind a feature flag so we can flip server-side if needed. Will include the telemetry event.

Maria G: OK — let's agree: ship shims in all SDKs behind a feature flag. Default behavior = off for GA, `auto` behind internal flag during canary only. Add CHANGELOG entries + migration guide. Also add console dashboard tile for "policy mismatch" (sampled) and a link to raw request samples.

Sophia C: Noted. I'll prepare migration docs and update SDK changelogs. Will add a short snippet in the release notes showing how to opt-in.

Danny (platform): Confirmed: server will accept legacy header until 2026-09-01 and will emit a sampled telemetry event `routing.header_mismatch` with a link in console logs. We'll publish compatibility docs tomorrow.

Maria G: Thanks all. Quick sync in #devex tomorrow 10:00 PT to review flags and console tile mockups. :thumbsup:
